title: Crimson Desert sets a Korea Game Awards record 🏆
subject: crimsondesert
description:
Is Crimson Desert your game of the year? 👇

Pearl Abyss' Crimson Desert won 8 prizes at the 2026 Korea Game Awards in Busan, including the Grand Prize, breaking the record of 6 shared by Lost Ark and Lies of P.

Sources: Korea Herald (Nov 19, 2026), Inven Global (Nov 18, 2026)
Game footage © Pearl Abyss.
tags: crimson desert game of the year

scenes.text: Crimson Desert took home 8 Korea Game Awards.
At the ceremony in Busan on November 18, Pearl Abyss won the Grand Prize, the Presidential Award for game of the year.
It also won graphics, sound, character and planning, plus the brand-new Global Game Award.
Eight is a new record. Lost Ark and Lies of P had shared the old one with 6 each.
Lee Hyun, who voices Kliff, was voted most popular voice actor. The game sold 5 million copies in its first 26 days.
